hero.title: Postgraduate Engineering in Mauritius
hero.subtitle: A Master’s in Engineering is a postgraduate qualification for graduates who want to deepen their technical knowledge, specialise in an engineering discipline, or move towards research, project leadership and advanced technical roles. **Master’s in Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students** can be an option for graduates looking to pursue postgraduate specialisation in different engineering fields.

overview: Mauritius offers postgraduate engineering options in areas such as civil engineering, building services, sustainable energy and renewable energy systems. Two institutions worth exploring are the University of Mauritius (UoM) and Université des Mascareignes (UdM). The right choice depends on your undergraduate specialisation, career goals and preferred study mode. Students planning to **Study Master’s in Engineering in Mauritius** should compare the available programmes and their entry requirements before applying.

faq.question: Can I study for a Master's in Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Yes. Mauritius has postgraduate engineering options in areas including civil engineering, building services, sustainable energy and renewable energy systems. The exact programme depends on the university and the student’s academic background. Master’s in Engineering in Mauritius for Indian Students offers different specialisation options to explore based on undergraduate qualifications and career goals.

faq.question: Which universities offer engineering master’s programmes in Mauritius?
faq.answer: The University of Mauritius lists programmes such as MSc Building Services Engineering and MSc Sustainable Energy Engineering with Environmental Management. Université des Mascareignes lists a Master in Civil Engineering with specialisation in Structures and Public Works and a Master in Energy Efficiency and Sustainable Development. These are important options for students comparing Master’s in Engineering Universities in Mauritius.

faq.question: What is the duration of a Master’s in Engineering in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Duration varies by programme and entry route. Several UoM engineering master’s programmes are listed as two years part-time. UdM’s civil engineering master’s lists a three-year route for eligible applicants entering at the first semester and a 1.5-year route for eligible applicants entering at semester three.

faq.question: How much does a Master’s in Engineering cost in Mauritius?
faq.answer: Tuition fees vary by university and specialisation. UdM’s published civil engineering master’s page states that tuition and registration fees were yet to be finalised. As an initial budget, estimated living expenses are MUR 20,500–39,000 per month, approximately ₹38,950–₹74,100 using the illustrative exchange rate in this article. For updated Master’s in Engineering Fees in Mauritius, students should contact the university directly.

faq.question: What qualifications do I need to apply?
faq.answer: Most applicants should expect to need a recognised bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related subject, but the precise requirements depend on the course. Some specialised programmes require a degree in the same discipline, and language proficiency may also be required. Check the official programme requirements before applying.
